vi: ngủ gà ngủ gật, chợp mắt
meaning: To sleep lightly for a short time.
example: Grandpa dozed off in his chair after lunch.
note_say: One syllable. It ends with a buzzing z, like in nose.
mean_say: to sleep lightly for a short time.
